svg.title: Stretching and squeezing near Earth
svg.desc: Radial particles accelerate apart; tangential particles accelerate toward one another. The three tidal acceleration eigenvalues sum to zero. The labels give eigenvalues of the Newtonian relative-acceleration matrix, not curvature components: divide by c² for the corresponding curvature scale, with the convention-dependent sign tracked in the text.

g.text: Vacuum tides near a spherical mass
Radial stretching balances two tangential squeezes.

svg.data-tex: \text{Earth's surface: radial separation acceleration}\approx3.08\;\mathrm{\mu m\,s^{-2}}\text{ per metre.}
svg.aria-label: Earth, at its surface: radial separation acceleration ≈ 3.08 μm/s² per metre of separation.
